title: BenchFlow / Skill Lift transfer audit: first research pass

scope.operations: Local git show/log/diff/ls-tree, selected working-file reads, in-memory ZIP inspection, two no-write function checks.
scope.excluded: No network, Freya, checkout/switch/reset, repository edits, exporter audit, voice synthetic-case generation or broad literature research.
scope.evidence_policy: Repository reports are audited claims. Source code, reported content results, local check reports and retrospective predictions remain separate. Local kit files have no verified commit; SHA-256 and line ranges identify them.
scope.research_boundary: Finite recommendations; no transplant implementation or live performance verification performed.

conclusion: Transplant source-derived contracts, independent outcome checks, canonical artifacts and evidence-led repairs. Rebuild policy ingestion, tool binding and stateful call execution for the new brief/API. Do not carry forward claims of general lift or treat static validator PASS as customer success.

evidence.observation: Stable acceptance IDs, evidence provenance, dependency/branch witnesses, and contract updates precede implementation.
Reject circular guessed specifications; preserve discriminators; cover every authoritative enum.
Map requirements through producer to final artifact/checker; reopen final artifact and independently recompute.
Paths/values are parameterized; every fallback preserves contracts; final-write and canonical replay gates required.
Bound repairs/context and require outcome checks, but prohibit heavy simulation during creator phase.
Core plus at most two adapters; old safety text bans test directories and uploading artifacts.
Contract helper locates files by name, looks for AC IDs anywhere in concatenated text, and accepts a failure token anywhere; it does not execute checks.
Positive contract-checker regression fixture consists of assert True for each ID.
Validator-run evidence consists of matching text tokens for command, exit zero, and success marker.
CAR pack check is triggered by Task Signature keywords and validates configuration/file presence; it does not recompute artifact bytes or inspect receipts.
Generated-mode enforcement depends on the word generated in the root path.
Main snapshot does promote AC/round-trip/oracle/completion warnings to errors in generated mode; older memo's warning-only characterization is stale for this path.
Actual CAR runtime helper rereads JSON/digests/receipts, checks exact stages/run-ID agreement, and required output existence.
Three copied fixtures and eight mutations test the CAR helper, not stochastic phone-agent behavior.
Explicit staging copy list includes four runtime helpers and bounded references.
Submission staging copies only validate_skill.py from scripts, omitting the other helpers.
Archive excludes caches/tests, verifies non-empty ZIP, prefix and SKILL entry; no runtime dependency-closure validation.
Top summary reports 86 total, 27 PASS plus 3 PARTIAL, and 57 FAIL/PARKED/ERR/excluded; the category total does not reconcile.

Reported fail-to-pass revisions for file organization, travel, citations, translation, pivot objects and PDF checkbox handling; retrieval still fails despite correct prose; OCR persistence has mixed outcomes.
Isolated branch fix improves one subtest without full task success; bike solver-rigor retest explicitly inconclusive.
Powerlifting iteration explicitly follows schema/branch/formula failures to v9 11/11, reward 1.0, 8 minutes.
Radar logged evidence without decision influence; multilingual dubbing v3 reports reward 1.0 and 11.2 minutes.
Later canary reports zero full passes in seven and video CAR failure; later bike run reports 318 calls and missing final output.
Automated cohort gate contradicted actual remote artifact layout and overmatched infrastructure language, leading to manual override.
Infra classifier uses broad regexes and a particular generated-skill directory layout.
Analyzer selects a content-bearing/latest job separately from the original ledger entry and retains a bounded failed-test trace.
Powerlifting record joins v1 ledger status/note to v7 job_dir; record is not one coherent run snapshot.
45-task repair cohort = 44 literal true FAIL + one mixed content/PARKED; cluster counts are overlapping flags.
Bike record explicitly says solver-rigor rule was not verified by inconclusive retest.
Video failure records precision and saved-segment/output inconsistency separately.
Raw jobs/logs/staging are excluded from Git; summaries cannot alone recreate live benchmark runs.
Reports 59 tests, static-library validator exit zero/nonblocking warnings and CAR helper self-test; these are different evidence types from content success.
Memo covers an older August-1 packet and defines FIX as predicted defect blocking, not whole-task PASS.
Older memo calls AC/CAR warning-only; must not override newer main code.
Writeup makes generalization/literature claims and says every AC has real producer/assertion; latter overstates current checker implementation.
Writeup conflates dedicated CAR configuration gate with mutated replay enforcement; reports evolving 86-task ledger and 54 tests.
Secondary branch explicitly models slots, events, attempts, visits, awaiting confirmation, failed tool state and action trace.
Secondary repair freezes initial oracle, applies typed candidate to a copy, records before/after and rejects regressions; oracle defaults to generated spec.
Secondary offline stand-in changes behavior via instruction tags, so offline repairs are not proof of Freya behavior.
Score requires correct bank records AND policy AND truthful conversation; no partial credit; one green run is not proof.
Unseen clean/raw briefs; same seven tool names with changing fields/enums; no embedding final-brief facts; export scored; three repeated runs; up to three products and varied spoken styles.
Automated build, fixed AGENT_LLM, only bank tools, update workflow, one simulation at a time, 30-minute builder deadline and trace requirements.
Publishing, latency, tool-call transcripts and real account-supplied product IDs materially affect results.
Kit v3 waits for test completion; an example result is a single practice run, not repeated final evidence.
Only call seed variables known initially; date policy uses provided now; opening and identity gates precede disclosure.
Identity answers have normalization, retry counters and day/month-swapped hint exception.
Confirm actual current product/amount/date; revisions require revalidation/read-back; only successful create_promise authorizes recorded claim; retry bound explicit.
Exactly one close_call as last tool; outcome/reason table and transfer priority; A never uses add_note.
B replaces relevant A rules; per-product deadlines/counters; aggregate confirmation; partial success; no notes on any transfer; outcome uses ordered product notes.

reusable_methods.method: Source-derived acceptance contracts and branch witnesses
reusable_methods.assessment: Highest-value reusable method; locally reported retest success, not a causal lift estimate.
reusable_methods.examples: Powerlifting v9 11/11; reported pivot, checkbox and translation repairs.
reusable_methods.adaptation: Clause -> precedence-resolved rule -> schema-bound tool/state transition -> independent final bank-record and transcript check.

reusable_methods.method: Canonical saved artifact and reverse verification
reusable_methods.assessment: Concrete implemented helper with inspectable mutation coverage; semantic correctness still requires an independent oracle.
reusable_methods.adaptation: Immutable, versioned policy/API IR shared by prompts, code, checks and trace; mutable call state separately versioned. Compare actual exported artifact and actual bank effects through their own readers.

reusable_methods.method: Small changes driven by observed failure
reusable_methods.assessment: Keep failure receipts and bounded edits. Secondary frozen-oracle/regression method is reusable after correcting oracle origin.
reusable_methods.adaptation: Freeze the authoritative brief-derived oracle before repair, cite violated clause in each patch, retain passing checks, wait for the candidate's test result, stop within build budget.

reusable_methods.method: Separate infrastructure, incomplete execution and content errors
reusable_methods.assessment: Correct principle; current layout/regex gate demonstrably needs replacement.
reusable_methods.adaptation: Structured API/task statuses, reached-stage markers and immutable per-run receipts; preserve tool failures and customer-policy failures as distinct content evidence.

reusable_methods.method: Bounded context and explicit clean staging
reusable_methods.assessment: Reusable engineering practice; optimum module count and successful dependency closure are unproven.
reusable_methods.adaptation: Read all authoritative rules and API metadata while keeping logs/samples bounded; package all referenced runtime dependencies and verify from the package.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: 27 PASS in an 86-task ledger demonstrates general skill lift.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: These are evolving public-task absolute results with retests, changing skills/infrastructure and no matched no-skill baseline or held-out voice evaluation. The header's 57 residuals conflicts with 27+3+56=86. FAIL_ANALYSIS's 45 cohort does reconcile as 44 true FAIL plus one mixed row.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Every generalized rule was hit and fixed, so predicts future PASS.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: Bike solver-rigor retest is explicitly inconclusive; later bike zero-output and video CAR failures persist; canary reports 0/7 full PASS. The memo's five FIX labels predict specific defect blocking, not successful reruns.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Validator proves every AC row has reachable producer and real assertion.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: Only source text presence and a global failure token are checked. The existing positive test uses assert True. A read-only direct check accepted AC IDs and assert present only in comments.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Recorded command/exit/PASS text proves validator execution.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: Generated prose can satisfy this function without any process receipt; direct no-write check accepts a fabricated success record. Use orchestrator-captured receipts tied to artifact digest.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Dedicated CAR pack gate rejects mutated replay and proves downstream correctness.
claims_requiring_correction.verdict: Conflates configuration, runtime receipt validation and semantics.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: Pack gate validates declared fields/entrypoint files, not replay receipts. Runtime check_car actually recomputes digests; it still checks outputs only for existence/non-emptiness and cannot prove a report's semantics. Reproducibility matrix exercises its own fixture, not phone behavior.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Old memo accurately describes enforcement in current main.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: Current main promotes several warnings in generated mode, unlike older memo. Static library PASS remains a weaker path; generated-mode selection itself is a path substring.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Final ZIP carries the skill's mandatory runtime capabilities.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: All three main ZIPs include matching current SKILL, contract-first reference and validator, but omit check_car.py and reproducibility_matrix.py required by included SKILL. Submission script copies only validator. Main creator bundle's broader allowlist is a better starting point.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Failure-analysis record is one exact version's evidence.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: Powerlifting record combines v1 ledger description with v7 job directory. Analyzer independently chooses a content-bearing job. Preserve both as separate sources; do not attribute an old defect to new run output.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Reported 54/59 local tests or 2-3 module literature advantage proves final voice performance.
claims_requiring_correction.reason: Test counts have different dated/scope reports; this audit did not rerun full suites or literature checks. Validator/helper tests establish narrow fixture behavior. Offline secondary model switches behavior by instruction tags.

assumptions_to_replace.old: A task prompt and representative input sample fully describe policy.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Consume all supplied briefs and raw documents plus that brief's OpenAPI; resolve explicit overrides, exceptions and code-list mappings with source-span evidence. Samples may not cover authoritative branches.

assumptions_to_replace.old: Known bank numbers, field names, enums, identity questions or calendar can be compiled into generic prompts.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Keep generic algorithms; compile every instance value and tool schema from current input. Record provenance and reject unresolved required mappings. No final-brief facts enter builder code.

assumptions_to_replace.old: Output correctness is a static file/schema check.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Check observable action order, state, bank effects AND truthful/policy-compliant speech. Runtime confirmation refers to a versioned current proposal and is invalidated by corrections.

assumptions_to_replace.old: One scalar amount/date/status/attempt counter represents the customer.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Maintain ordered product records with independent proposal, confirmation version, persistence result, attempts, deadline and note state; aggregate closure using current brief precedence.

assumptions_to_replace.old: A call to a tool means its effect occurred.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Only declared successful response authorizes recorded events or success speech; keep attempts and committed effects separate, retain partial per-product success and derive terminal outcome from actual effects.

assumptions_to_replace.old: Calendar uses host clock and a fixed parsing convention.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Evaluate current-input date/time policy against supplied now and input calendar; preserve spoken corrections and confirmation boundaries. Current A's conventions are instance facts.

assumptions_to_replace.old: Creator must never run a full simulation; long repair can defer final write.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Builder may run its agent's actual tests within 30 minutes. Reserve completion/export/trace time, await terminal results and preserve best fully validated candidate; a placeholder agent has no guaranteed minimum score.

assumptions_to_replace.old: One green run or three copied directories establishes robustness.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Separate deterministic build replay from stochastic call evaluation; assess complete-case pass across required repeated runs and calendar/style changes. Public runs guide repairs, not claims of hidden robustness.

assumptions_to_replace.old: Copy the old test-directory ban, upload ban and infrastructure keyword stop rules.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Allow authorized visible kit tests and workflow submission; protect credentials, hidden answers and scorer integrity. Classify infra from structured statuses, not words inside customer data. Keep live simulation serial per workspace.

assumptions_to_replace.old: A frozen oracle from the generated draft is independent.
assumptions_to_replace.replacement: Construct/check the oracle from resolved original brief plus OpenAPI, then freeze it before candidate repair. A generator omission must not become the expected outcome.

ranked_transplant_plan.action: Build a provenance-preserving policy/API intermediate contract.
ranked_transplant_plan.reuse: Acceptance IDs, branch/source witnesses, exact completeness, canonical artifact concept.
ranked_transplant_plan.implement_next: Generic ingestion accepts brief file list and API file; emits stable rule IDs, source spans/hashes, explicit precedence and overrides, conditions, state requirements, tool field mappings, thresholds/calendars and outcome table. Freeze the resolved contract and derive code/prompts/check specifications from it.
ranked_transplant_plan.acceptance_gate: Every binding rule maps to an implementation/check witness; every used tool field/enum maps to current OpenAPI; unresolved or conflicting mandatory rules cannot silently compile. No A/B constants in generic builder.

ranked_transplant_plan.action: Compile a stateful call controller with transaction-aware tool effects.
ranked_transplant_plan.reuse: Branch discriminators and secondary State/events/attempts/trace pattern.
ranked_transplant_plan.implement_next: Separate identity, conversation intent, current proposal version, product-order state and committed tool results. Enforce policy-backed preconditions for disclosure, confirmation, writes, retry bounds, transfers/notes and terminal close. Feed deterministic state into prompts/hooks/code allowed by kit.
ranked_transplant_plan.acceptance_gate: No unverified disclosure or unconfirmed/stale-proposal write; tool failure never yields success speech; ordered per-product partial outcomes and final last-tool closure satisfy compiled rules.

ranked_transplant_plan.action: Replace prose/token validation with executed source-derived checks.
ranked_transplant_plan.reuse: AC observed/expected matrix, nonzero failure and independent final reader.
ranked_transplant_plan.implement_next: Use explicit validation mode rather than directory naming; execute schema/state/checker entrypoints under bounded budget; collect actual process status and artifact digest. Validate from authoritative contract, not generator guesses. Keep broad legacy lint as optional diagnostics.
ranked_transplant_plan.acceptance_gate: Every mandatory check returns observed evidence and nonzero on violation; IDs/comments, assert True, fabricated PASS text and absence of CAR keywords cannot satisfy completion.
ranked_transplant_plan.handoff: Recommendations only; no new voice synthetic cases were generated.

ranked_transplant_plan.action: Verify submission/runtime dependency closure from a clean package.
ranked_transplant_plan.reuse: New-label staging, explicit allowlist, archive entry verification, final-write gate.
ranked_transplant_plan.implement_next: Carry all referenced runtime helpers/config/assets with builder and emitted artifact; parse required dependency manifest and load package through real entrypoint. Bind submitted artifact, builder code and trace to one run manifest. Leave detailed Freya exporter format verification to exporter audit owner.
ranked_transplant_plan.acceptance_gate: No missing required helper/import/file; emitted artifact can be reopened; all submitted outputs present and digest-matched to completed run; package checks execute from package rather than checkout.

ranked_transplant_plan.action: Make test-and-repair an awaited, budgeted builder stage.
ranked_transplant_plan.reuse: Evidence-led narrow patches, bounded repairs, frozen oracle and regression gate from secondary branch.
ranked_transplant_plan.implement_next: Run permitted practice evaluation serially, wait for final status, inspect failure tool effects/transcript against frozen original-source rules, apply one attributable candidate repair and rerun affected/general checks. Stop launching work when completion/export/trace cannot fit 30-minute deadline.
ranked_transplant_plan.acceptance_gate: Trace contains completed result or explicit timed-out/error status; no unobserved PASS; retained candidate preserves prior checks; final robustness claim is all required runs, not subtest proximity.

ranked_transplant_plan.action: Capture coherent per-run evidence and exact artifact replay.
ranked_transplant_plan.reuse: CAR helper digest/stable-ID checks; failure taxonomy and bounded evidence.
ranked_transplant_plan.implement_next: One manifest binds input/API hashes, builder commit, contract version, candidate artifact digest, stage receipts, model-call purposes, created platform IDs, timings and results. Keep each failed attempt's record separate; obtain actual bank/transcript evidence through sanctioned interfaces. Use structured infrastructure statuses.
ranked_transplant_plan.acceptance_gate: Receipts share run/version and exact expected stage set; actual authoritative artifact digest is recomputed; no mixed v1 note/v7 result or inferred local empty pack; semantic audit still checks output effects independently.

ranked_transplant_plan.action: Keep the builder's skills compact and specialize the old adapters.
ranked_transplant_plan.reuse: Bounded context, small operational instructions, contextual routing.
ranked_transplant_plan.implement_next: Keep a short core authoring skill plus policy/API and voice-state guidance. Read the full authoritative input via structured processing, not large raw log dumps. Remove irrelevant spreadsheet/spectral/geometry obligations and absolute /root paths. Adapt old guards to the authorized competition services/tests.
ranked_transplant_plan.acceptance_gate: Every prompt instruction contributes to current brief/tool/state execution; no unrelated domain checklist, fixed banking values, assumed Freya API or unsupported module-count performance claim.

audit_checks.method: Loaded origin/main validator directly in memory with bytecode disabled. Mocked os.walk/open to expose a checker containing only AC IDs and assert in comments plus print(done).
audit_checks.limit: Function-level false-negative only; not a complete-pack pass or customer evaluation. No temporary or repository files written.

audit_checks.method: Passed a self-written command/exit-zero/PASS string directly to check_validator_execution_evidence.
audit_checks.limit: Demonstrates lack of execution provenance in this function; does not audit any specific historical validator invocation.

audit_checks.method: git show binary ZIP blobs, inspect in memory using zipfile, compare selected entries' bytes with origin/main sources.
audit_checks.observed: All three ZIPs omit check_car.py/reproducibility_matrix.py/skill_graph.py. Existing SKILL.md, contract-first.md and validate_skill.py exactly match main.
audit_checks.binary_evidence: ZIP entries have no line numbers; E04/E16/E17 supply line evidence for requirements and packaging cause.

audit_checks.method: Parse numbered ledger table and failure-analysis JSON from origin/main.
audit_checks.limit: Counts of reported labels/records, not independently repeated benchmark outcomes. Derived snapshot is not a current score.

limits: No live scores, no full pytest rerun, no causal ablation, no external literature verification. No assertion that secondary runtime is correctly exported or enforced on Freya.
